agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has single body launched horizontally at 13.7 m/s with gravity 9.81 and dt~0.00735, no walls. Semi-implicit Euler with 5 substeps cannot stop body at arena boundary (20,12). At step 138 body still inside (overshoot -0.04), but by step 140 x=19.329 with r=0.83 gives overshoot 0.159 >0.15 limit, velocity unchanged (no collision response with boundary wall). Cause: boundary walls are not enforced as collisions when wall list empty / tunneling through boundary not prevented vs integration overshoot - body exits arena without bounce.
